en: I am writing to express my interest in the Fullstack Developer position at [Company Name]. With over nine years of experience building web and mobile applications using Laravel, React, and Vue.js, I have developed a deep understanding of how to design, implement, and maintain scalable software solutions that solve real business problems.

In my most recent freelance work, I built several fullstack applications using Laravel 10–11 and React 18–19, including tools for managing payroll, contracts, and inventory for medium-sized companies. At Lemonscale, I contributed to multiple projects that combined Laravel, React, and Azure, developing features such as real-time chat, interactive boards, and e-learning modules. My experience also includes working with GraphQL, TypeScript, and Node.js, which allowed me to integrate diverse technologies seamlessly.

I’m particularly motivated by projects that require both backend and frontend collaboration, where I can contribute to architecture design, data modeling, and user experience. I’m used to working independently and remotely, communicating effectively with teams across different time zones.

I would be thrilled to bring my technical background and problem-solving mindset to [Company Name], and I’m confident that my experience with modern web stacks would make me a valuable addition to your team.
Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my skills and experience align with your company’s needs.
